id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

actionRequirement.description: The parsed action requirement from the {@link ImplLanguage.Session.SetupSpec}.

appNode.description:
If set, we will target all dispatched method calls to this particular app node in the server. This makes the
session "sticky" to a single server node. For recovery on node failure,
{@link ImplLanguage.Session.Result each result} includes the node on which it was processed and further calls
to this session should use the new node.

title:
This type provides the structure to support persistent sessions for action engines based in the server.

Classes that implement specific language (really #runtime) support need to implement the abstract methods.

These instances are maintained in the server memory to allow execution state to be preserved between executions.
Thus their instances are not fully serializable and only a unique ID will be sent back and forth.

These sessions are modeled after the
[Jupyter Client protocol](https://jupyter-client.readthedocs.io/en/latest/messaging.html),
and could easily be used to implement custom kernels.
name: ImplLanguage.Session
